# Metrics

Both processes serve Prometheus metrics at `/metrics`: the node on its management listener (port 9100), the admin on its API listener. A ready-made dashboard and alert rules are in `deploy/observability/`.

## The gateway (node)

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apg_requests_total` | counter | `route`, `service`, `status_class` | Requests handled, by route, service and status class. |
| `apg_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `route`, `service` | Time from request received to response sent. |
| `apg_upstream_duration_seconds` | histogram | `route`, `service` | Time from choosing a backend to its response headers. |
| `apg_request_bytes_total` | counter | `route`, `service` | Request body bytes received. |
| `apg_response_bytes_total` | counter | `route`, `service` | Response body bytes sent. |
| `apg_upgraded_connections` | gauge |  | Upgraded (WebSocket) connections open. |
| `apg_drained_connections_total` | counter |  | Upgraded connections closed because their backend was drained or removed. |
| `apg_tcp_connections_total` | counter | `route`, `service`, `outcome` | Connections on the TCP listener, by route, service and outcome. |
| `apg_tcp_active_connections` | gauge |  | Connections the TCP listener is forwarding. |
| `apg_tcp_bytes_total` | counter | `route`, `service`, `direction` | Bytes forwarded by the TCP listener, counted when a connection ends, by route, service and direction. |
| `apg_active_requests` | gauge |  | Requests in progress. |
| `apg_usage_windows_pending` | gauge |  | Closed usage windows waiting to be delivered. |
| `apg_usage_windows_dropped_total` | counter |  | Usage windows given up after waiting a day. |
| `apg_usage_flush_failures_total` | counter |  | Failed attempts to deliver a usage window. |
| `apg_access_log_dropped_total` | counter |  | Access log lines dropped because the sink could not keep up. |
| `apg_gateway_errors_total` | counter | `code` | Responses generated by the gateway itself, by error code. |
| `apg_limited_total` | counter | `type` | Requests refused by a limit plugin. |
| `apg_plugin_errors_total` | counter | `type` | Plugin instances that could not run, by type. |
| `apg_transform_skipped_total` | counter |  | Bodies passed through unchanged because they were too large to rewrite. |
| `apg_cache_requests_total` | counter | `result` | Requests seen by the response cache, by result. |
| `apg_cache_bytes` | gauge |  | Memory held by cached responses. |
| `apg_upstream_fail_open_total` | counter |  | Requests sent to a backend although every backend's circuit was open. |
| `apg_upstream_retries_total` | counter | `workspace`, `service` | Attempts made after a failed first attempt. |
| `apg_backend_healthy` | gauge | `workspace`, `service`, `backend` | 1 while a backend passes its active health check, 0 while it fails. |
| `apg_backend_circuit_open` | gauge | `workspace`, `service`, `backend` | 1 while a backend's circuit is open. |
| `apg_dns_failures_total` | counter |  | Backend host names that failed to resolve. |
| `apg_certs_expiring` | gauge | `within` | Served certificates that expire within the window. |
| `apg_acme_issuances_total` | counter |  | Certificates this node obtained from the ACME authority. |
| `apg_acme_failures_total` | counter | `reason` | Failed attempts to obtain a certificate, by the step that failed. |
| `apg_config_converged` | gauge |  | 1 once the node has applied a complete configuration. |
| `apg_config_applied_seq` | gauge |  | Sequence number of the newest change applied. |
| `apg_config_source_age_seconds` | gauge |  | Seconds since the config source was last known to be alive. |
| `apg_config_resources` | gauge | `kind` | Resources held, by kind. |
| `apg_config_dangling_refs` | gauge |  | Routes held back because a service they name is missing. |
| `apg_config_reload_failures_total` | counter |  | Configuration reloads rejected as invalid. |
| `apg_changelog_errors_total` | counter | `kind` | Change events skipped, by reason. |
| `apg_snapshots_total` | counter | `reason` | Full resyncs from the config source, by reason. |
| `apg_build_info` | gauge | `version` | Always 1; the version is a label. |

The number of `route` and `service` label values is capped (`APG_METRICS_MAX_SERIES`); beyond the cap, requests are counted under an empty label instead of creating new series.

## The control plane (admin)

| Metric | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apg_admin_requests_total` | counter | Admin API requests, by method, route and status. |
| `apg_changes_max_seq` | gauge | Number of the newest change. |
| `apg_changes_rows` | gauge | Changes kept for nodes to read. |
| `apg_nodes_live` | gauge | Nodes that reported in the last 30 seconds. |
| `apg_nodes_max_lag` | gauge | How many changes the furthest-behind live node has yet to apply. |
| `apg_cert_leases_active` | gauge | Certificate issuances in progress. |
| `apg_node_lag` | gauge | Per live node (label `node`): how many changes it has yet to apply. |
| `apg_node_stale` | gauge | Per live node (label `node`): 1 while it cannot reach the control plane and serves what it has. |
| `apg_node_backends_unhealthy` | gauge | Per live node (label `node`): backends that node reports as failing. |
| `apg_job_last_success_timestamp_seconds` | gauge | When each background job last succeeded. |
| `apg_job_failures_total` | counter | Failures of each background job. |
